## Reading and updating the ledger

All 59 original general criteria and four macOS criteria remain preserved. Current owner decisions take precedence over superseded wording. Implementation, scoped historical evidence, this review and production deployment are separate facts. A green build is not field acceptance; not revalidated is not never accepted.

`implemented` means identified source exists, not universal qualification. `covered_by_tests` is automated-contract coverage. `evidence_review_pending` preserves existing scoped field reports for reconciliation, not fresh acceptance and not a request to repeat all tests. `pending_hardware` means specific field scenarios remain unresolved; it does not prove no prior test ever happened. `pending_product` is an actual implementation/scope question. Original text is historical where a current requirement is supplied.

Workstream `accepted` with a `user_decision` basis records accepted product direction, not fresh hardware tests. `completed`, `accepted`, `superseded`, `deferred` and `cancelled` are valid evidence-bearing transitions; required IDs preserve history, not perpetual open tasks. Future decisions can change scope through a new decision reference and rationale; do not delete requirements to close them.

Historical report hashes identify the exact **report excerpt**, not an unavailable device binary or raw capture. Verified existing acceptance and new hardware acceptance require their own dated/environment/artifact/report metadata. CI validates structure and provenance consistency, not physical truth. Do not publish credentials or raw device identifiers.

Use traceable local records to update this ledger; latest explicit owner decisions override stale scope. Reconcile earlier reports and test only uncovered/contradicted cases with authorization. Run `node tools/repository-check.mjs --write` and review the generated diff.

## Decision provenance

- **EMBEDDED_MANUAL_DEPLOYMENT** (2026-10-02, project_owner): Keep current runtime, installer and isolation logic unchanged. Add an embedded Linux manual deployment procedure: users download and verify a matching artifact, place it, configure their Agent and optionally maintain their own crontab keepalive. This documents the existing reader CLI without requiring systemd; it does not qualify ARM64 artifacts or bypass the existing systemd-dependent managed modem guard. Android local modem support remains out of scope. [Source](../../agent/MODEM_AGENT.md).
- **FLEET_MAIN_ALIGNMENT** (2026-09-30, project_owner): Check all currently running clients and server against current main, update outdated deployments and verify them, and continue discussing issues with the existing ChatGPT reviewer. The owner clarified that no Agent was intentionally using cellular traffic: diagnose actual transmission/isolation instead of stopping on a connected bearer, and pin the existing certificate instead of treating certificate trust as a whole-task blocker. Preserve stored user intent, isolation, credentials, previous acceptance and scoped paid-operation limits; do not infer new product scope or bypass a real active-work safety gate. [Source](../../DEPLOYMENT.md).
- **BRANCH_RECONCILIATION** (2026-09-29, project_owner): Coordinate with the existing reviewer, integrate useful completed work or selective ports, retire superseded branches with traceable preservation, and continue from clean main. Do not reopen excluded architecture or accepted hardware matrices; no new deployment or paid operation is authorized by branch cleanup. [Source](../../docs/branches.md).
- **ANDROID_COMMUNICATION_UX** (2026-09-29, project_owner): Improve Android Home and Calls status/interaction, expose complete retained Messages history and default a provable original reply SIM. Android is also a multi-client phone/SMS terminal without a local reader; keep sharing optional and reuse existing server contention control. Client-first scope and previous milestone acceptance are unchanged. [Source](../../docs/decisions/2026-09-24-android-client-scope.md).
- **ANDROID_PREVIEW_CLOSE** (2026-09-27, project_owner): Close the usable Android Agent preview as a staged delivery. Missing long-duration stability qualification is acceptable with visible failures, bounded recovery and manual remedies. Defer meaningful other directions in the existing postponed ledger; preserve all safety requirements and owner review before merge. [Source](../../docs/decisions/2026-09-21-android-agent.md).
- **ANDROID_NETWORK_EXTREMES** (2026-09-27, project_owner): Extreme network-switching validation is non-blocking for the main reader/call/SMS workflow and delivery. Keep physical handover unverified without requiring a phone data SIM; ordinary automatic reconnect/session recovery remains required. [Source](../../docs/decisions/2026-09-21-android-agent.md).
- **ESIM_FINAL** (2026-09-20, project_owner): Physical deletion, retained notification and multiply-confirmed manual replay are the accepted final direction; abandoned soft deletion is superseded. [Source](../../docs/decisions/2026-09-20-current-scope.md).
- **PRIMARY_AGENTS** (2026-09-20, project_owner): September 20 decision: Windows/macOS/Linux remote Agents prioritized and Android deferred; the Android deferral was superseded by ANDROID_NATIVE and later preview/rollout decisions. The required fail-closed isolation for enabled 4G and preservation of user intent remain unchanged. [Source](../../docs/decisions/2026-09-20-current-scope.md).
- **MACOS_RELEASE** (2026-09-20, project_owner): No notarization or .p8 this round. Preserve signing and track Universal packaging separately. [Source](../../docs/decisions/2026-09-20-current-scope.md).
- **EVIDENCE_CONTINUITY** (2026-09-20, project_owner): Reconcile scoped historical evidence before scheduling missing tests; not revalidated is not never accepted. [Source](../../docs/decisions/2026-09-20-current-scope.md).
- **ANDROID_NATIVE** (2026-09-21, project_owner): Android reprioritized: native reader/call/SMS app, safe recovery and battery-conscious UX; draft PR and test APK, not production or paid-operation acceptance. [Source](../../docs/decisions/2026-09-21-android-agent.md).
- **ANDROID_CLIENT_SCOPE** (2026-09-24, project_owner): Keep PR #7 server baseline, reuse Android UI, recover network/session loss in the client, and use browser-equivalent call lifetime. Exclude server pairing and durable call recovery. Owner subsequently authorized isolated Core validation and minimal mainline integration after it passes, not production deployment. Preserve other workspaces; work without subagents. [Source](../../docs/decisions/2026-09-24-android-client-scope.md).

Long-duration USB/OEM/battery, historical USB timeout causality, physical handover and separately identified hardware/carrier subcases remain unverified and non-blocking under ANDROID_PREVIEW_CLOSE. Detailed redacted receipts, failure history and limitations are published in android-agent/README.md and docs/decisions/2026-09-24-android-client-scope.md for GitHub-plugin review. Private raw evidence is retained outside Git; earlier local-only publication instructions are superseded by the owner. September 29 client correction passed exact-source hosted regressions and review in the original ChatGPT conversation; these emulator/lock-barrier checks are not process-death or physical slow-storage acceptance. The later documentation head reuses identical runtime/test/build source, not a claimed new test execution. The September 29 owner-authorized v91 update and PR #12 merge are now recorded separately; no new paid call/SMS, replay, storage reset or SIM/PIN change was performed. Startup/route readback is not a new acoustic or carrier acceptance.

Resolution (implementation_evidence): The owner narrowed this stage to the usable Android preview and accepted remaining endurance-validation gaps. Existing scoped physical main-flow evidence remains valid for its installed artifacts. The September 29 client review corrections additionally have compiled behavioral counterexamples, exact-source hosted regression passes and the original reviewer's closure. Final record-only publication preserves qualified runtime/test/build source. The owner subsequently authorized merge and deployment after review; PR #12 merge and v91 phone readback are recorded without marking unperformed endurance/carrier tests passed.

### ANDROID_ENDURANCE

**State: deferred; release relevance: deferred.** Long-session keepalive, event-driven bounded USB recovery, ordinary reconnect and visible/manual recovery guidance are implemented. Overnight USB/OEM screen-off durability, all-day battery life, natural elapsed-session-expiry qualification and extreme physical network switching remain unverified. The historical startup USB write-timeout cause is not established; a recovered short sample does not explain it.

Acceptance scope / remaining action: Accepted as non-blocking validation gaps for this Android preview. Preserve fault/status indicators, reset limits, Pause/share intent and manual reader/OTG guidance. Do not add automatic paid retries, wake locks or tests solely to prolong closure. Reopen for a later owner-requested endurance effort or a reproduced main-flow failure, starting with retained evidence. Restricted OMAPI/phone-native subscription and owner-deferred UK incoming carrier subcases remain unqualified, not inferred from server-routed calling.

Resolution (user_decision): The owner explicitly accepts implemented stability/recovery mechanisms without complete long-duration validation for this stage, given visible faults, bounded recovery and manual user remedies.

The uncovered traffic-loss/fallback scenario and platform gaps remain explicitly unverified. Do not enable an off capability, modify user switches or weaken existing fail-closed gates. Schedule any disruptive or paid experiment separately, not as an Android closure prerequisite.

Resolution (user_decision): The owner deferred meaningful non-Android directions to the existing postponed backlog. Permanent isolation requirements remain required; only this PR's follow-up scope changes.

### CELLULAR_PREPARATION_EXPIRY

**State: needs_verification; release relevance: deferred.** Potential defensive gap, not a reproduced orphan-session defect: cellularmedia.sweep has an expiresAt branch for ready but no separate preparing expiry; its active/uncertain heartbeat, renewal and incoming-claim handling remain separate. The September 30 03:22:52 UTC sample had a heartbeat only about three seconds old; a 09:26:41 UTC read-only follow-up found that exact session gone and its matching call-history entry ended at 03:23:09 UTC. Neither the exact session-removal time nor a watchdog cause is established.

Acceptance scope / remaining action: Normal preparation already uses a 30-second Agent media request, a five-second broker acquisition and failed-preparation removal/revocation. These are per-call budgets, not proof that every resource is released within 35 seconds; acquisition failure also calls stopAgentMedia before deferred cleanup. Before changing Core, establish a reachable timeout/cancellation or late-success cleanup issue using implementation evidence or a behavioral counterexample in existing isolated fixtures that exercise the production path. Account for late completion without reviving removed ownership; do not prescribe a watchdog patch in advance. No such regression was run or defect reproduced by this status review. Keep this observation separate from real ringing/active-call/disconnect acceptance (M54); do not inject an unreachable stale session and label it a field failure, restart services, place paid calls or turn this into a new fleet-delivery gate.
